description: The bar chart illustrates GLUE performance scores for different fine-tuning methods, shown separately for two RoBERTa model sizes. The horizontal axis contains the categorical fine-tuning methods labeled (left to right) Prefix, Adaptor, LoRA, BitFit, s₁-model, s₄-model, and s₅-model, with the axis label “Fine-tuning Method,” and the categories appear in this listed order rather than being sorted by value. The vertical axis is labeled “GLUE Performance” and uses a linear numeric scale with visible tick labels at 86 and 88 (implying a 2-point interval), with bar heights spanning roughly from the mid‑84s up to about 89. The legend titled “RoBERTa Size” indicates two bars per category: a blue-gray bar for “base” and a brown bar for “large,” arranged as side-by-side grouped bars within each method. Approximate values by method are: Prefix (base ≈84.6, large ≈85.7), Adaptor (base ≈84.4, large ≈88.1), LoRA (base ≈86.6, large ≈88.8), BitFit (base ≈84.3, large ≈87.7), s₁-model (base ≈85.6, large ≈85.6), s₄-model (base ≈86.2, large ≈87.6), and s₅-model (base ≈87.0, large ≈89.1). No bars appear to be specially emphasized with annotations, outlines, or distinct shading beyond the two legend colors.
